title: Retry deployment of admin panel feature

requirements.text: Re-deploy the full application including all previously implemented features: the hardcoded admin Principal in the backend, the `deleteUser` update function, the `isAdmin` query function, the `useIsAdmin` and `useDeleteUser` React Query hooks in useQueries.ts, the AdminPanel page at frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx, and the /admin route registered in App.tsx. Ensure the build compiles cleanly and deploys successfully to the Internet Computer network.

quotes: retry building the admin delete-users feature

acceptanceCriteria: The application deploys successfully without compilation or deployment errors
The backend actor compiles with the isAdmin query and deleteUser update functions intact
The frontend builds without TypeScript or bundler errors
Navigating to /admin in the deployed app renders the AdminPanel page
The isAdmin check correctly gates access in the AdminPanel

constraints: Do not introduce new features or change existing logic — this is a clean retry of the last build
Do not alter the hardcoded admin Principal already defined in the backend
nonGoals: Adding any new features beyond what was already implemented
Changing the admin panel UI or backend admin logic
Modifying any other existing pages or components
